verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented documentation is a fair question for a SaaS feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. Hands-on probes found no such docs: https://launchdarkly.com/llms.txt and https://launchdarkly.com/docs.md both returned HTTP 404. The official MCP server and CLI are separate agent-integration features and earn no credit for an llms.txt or agent-docs story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
